headline: H2FY27 guidance at 50% revenue growth

highlights: PAT grew 28% YoY to INR 0.52bn, despite a high base that included an exceptional gain of INR 0.42bn in Q2FY26.
Order inflows of INR 73.2bn during the quarter propelled the order book to a record INR 330.8bn (~4.6x TTM revenue).
Including ~INR 13bn of orders secured post Q2FY27, DBL has already achieved ~90% of the lower end of its FY27 inflow guidance of INR 100–120bn.
While management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 30–40%, the modest 5.5% growth in H1FY27 implies a steep >50% growth requirement in H2FY27, making execution a key monitorable.

Q1 was hit by limited rake availability, which is now resolved, and the run-rate has doubled since October; H2 production should be ~18mn MT, so the FY27 target of 27mn MT is on track.
Mining beyond FY27: The ~57mn MT target for FY29 is unchanged, and at that level mining should generate ~INR 10bn of annual operating cash flow (PAT plus depreciation), against ~INR 4bn in FY27.
